# Beyond AI Engineering: From Creator to Curator

> Official site and career operating system for software engineers, architects, students, and technical organizations navigating the age of autonomous AI agents — by Harsh Verma.

- Canonical Site: https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/
- XML Sitemap: https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/sitemap.xml
- Author: Harsh Verma (Principal AI Engineer at Palo Alto Networks, Stanford Distinguished Scholar, FRSA, FBCS, IEEE Senior Member, Forbes Technology Council)

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/): Overview of *Beyond AI Engineering: From Creator to Curator*, the Paradigm Shift Explorer, and C.A.O. Diagnostic.
- [The Book](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/book): Complete 11 chapters across 4 parts and 15 architectural blueprints.
- [Sample Reading Room](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/book/sample): Free online excerpt and downloadable sample chapters.
- [Get the Book](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/book/buy): Editions, bulk team inquiries, and direct author requests.
- [The Manifesto](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/manifesto): Eight foundational axioms for engineering after code.

## Audience Pathways, Tools & Insights

- [For Engineers](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/engineers): Tactical career roadmap for mid-to-senior & staff engineers.
- [For Students](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/students): How CS students build verifiable proof of work.
- [For Organizations](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/organizations): Engineering team adoption, reading groups & keynotes.
- [Implementation Lab](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/resources): 15 interactive canvases, rubrics & 30/60/90-day career planner.
- [Living AI Toolkit](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/toolkit): Curated tools across agents, coding, evals, observability & security.
- [Insights Archive](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/insights): 40+ essays, Forbes Technology Council columns, RSAC & HackerNoon dispatches, and engineering benchmarks.
- [About Harsh Verma](https://www.beyondaiengineering.com/author): Author profile, credentials & publications.
